content.text: The first major update of LeagueBuilder is here and here is everything that has changed

items: Added share links so other people can view your league tables.
Added QR codes for shared league links.
Added sharing for league tables, fixtures, and individual team pages.
Added team profile pages with stats, form, and fixtures.
Added bulk team adding from a pasted list.
Added optional team colours.
Added a fixture calendar view.
Added gameweek filters for fixtures.
Added fixture dates and gameweek date tools.
Added a way to view how the league table looked before a chosen gameweek.
Added title race, promotion race, playoff race, and relegation battle views.
Added projections for what teams can achieve in their next match.
Added a clearer playoff bracket view.
Added two-leg playoff ties.
Added season history and team history.
Added a group dashboard.
Added a pyramid ladder view.
Added better season archive browsing.
Added safer reset options.
Added warnings before major actions like regenerating fixtures or deleting teams.
Added clearer pop-up messages.
Added improved dark mode.
Added better mobile controls.
Added more graphic export options, including mobile story and square post sizes.
Added new graphics for team profiles, races, fixtures, and playoffs.
Redesigned league table graphics to look cleaner and more professional.
Improved team profile graphics with position, record, points, form, and recent results.
Improved race graphics with cleaner tables and better spacing.
Improved Clean View controls.
Improved fixture history when clicking on a team.
Improved playoff promotion and relegation labels.
Fixed several display issues in tables, graphics, dates, and calendar views.
